case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Our options give you that: a binding volume over a long contract, as business on top of what you supply us today, and Option A secures it.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn the longest commitment and the full binding volume, and the claims below show why the price sits where it does.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since pricing and contract terms like these are probably not yours to decide alone, may I ask you to take Option A to the person who decides at your company? For them in plain words: Option A brings your plant a binding volume on top of today's business, held steady over a long contract, with one clear yes from us as soon as you confirm it. We would like to settle this as a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I am fully authorized by our management to negotiate and conclude this agreement directly with you. We value the prospect of a 36-month contract and the binding volume of 30,000 units a year, which allows us to improve our pricing. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. It remains valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

As an alternative, while we note your historical prices for individual components, this bundled kit requires a different calculation; we can therefore offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear Mr Stadler,

You asked about volume, and that is exactly what our options give your plant: a binding volume over the full contract term, as business on top of what you supply us today. Option A secures it in full.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn steady load for your free capacity and a long contract, with payment terms that are simple to run.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.28; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.30; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.34; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this is a step for both family companies, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side. For them, it comes down to this: a binding volume across the whole contract, additional business that fills your plant, and a partner who pays every invoice on its due date. I would be glad to hear that Option A is agreed.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
